task: T5: stop the task-level stops from overwriting an attempt's own record, in scripts/ralph-build.sh. Each attempt ends exactly once — stillborn, noop, passed, or gate-rejected — and the record for that attempt is written at the point it ends. Two of the five log_meta call sites are not attempt endings at all: the stop after every attempt is exhausted, and the final stop where the STRICT gate finds unbuilt work. Both are TASK-level events, both reuse the last attempt's number, and both therefore rewrite a record that the attempt already wrote correctly — a no-op attempt records `noop` and is then immediately overwritten with `failed` by the exhausted-attempts stop. Make those two sites leave an existing record alone: they may only write when the attempt has not already recorded itself. Do not delete either call — an attempt whose gate rejected it has no other site that records it, so removing them would lose that case entirely. Do not change the three attempt-ending sites, and do not change what either stop prints or the exit code it uses.
